messages:
ashley: Quick follow-up from yesterday's postmortem — we're still seeing recurring headroom drops around EOD batch jobs. Need to consolidate owners and timelines for remediation.

marta: noted. I spun up a tracking sheet and added initial rows for quota, scheduler tuning, and headroom dashboards: <https://go/internal/gpu-capacity-rotation|gpu-capacity-rotation>

lucas: can you drop the link again? i couldn't open from mobile earlier

marta: <https://go/internal/gpu-capacity-rotation|gpu-capacity-rotation> — sheet has tabs: actions, owners, SLOs, blockers.

raj: scheduler tuning proposal: reduce pod backoff to 15s, increase preemptible buffer to 2 GPUs for p1 queue, and tighten gang-scheduling window. I'll own the dev tests. ETA Wed EOD.

ashley: assigning owners for clarity: raj -> scheduler tuning tests; marta -> quota request to cloud infra; lucas -> headroom/dashboard changes + alerts; ben -> runbook/playbook updates. please ack.

ben: ack. I'll draft the emergency runbook today and add step-by-step 'force-scale' instructions and rollback criteria.

marta: ack. filing quota ticket with cloud team now (incl. justification + historical spike graphs). target approval = next Tue.

raj: starting tests in dev cluster now. I'll post results + logs to #eng-runtime and link the snapshot in the sheet. If tests pass, I'll open rollout PR for canary.

lucas: :eyes: I'll add a 'headroom by region' panel and create a weekly alert when available headroom drops below 30%. Owner = lucas, recur = weekly.

eng-bot: Reminder: recurring meeting created — "GPU capacity sync" every Friday 09:30. Calendar invite: <https://cal.internal/gpu-sync>

ashley: two additional asks before we close the loop: (1) ben, add the 'force-scale' oncall task to the SRE runbook (owner ben). (2) set an autoscale recovery SLO: 120s for typical failovers. agree?

marta: SLO sounds reasonable. added SLO row in sheet under 'SLOs' tab and linked historical recovery times.

raj: agree on 120s. as a mitigation, I'll prototype an automatic fallback to a lower-cost model variant if autoscale fails to hit 120s — spike for 1 week.

lucas: note: quota increases often take ~5 business days. marta, add a temporary routing rule (to dedicated pool) to cover that window.

marta: done. temporary routing task added with owner lucas and deadline = 2025-11-04.

ashley: great. I'll consolidate into a single task list in the sheet and ping owners tomorrow for status. please update progress / blockages in the sheet and drop short updates in this thread. :thumbsup:
